build_selfattention_pooling: build a self-attention pooling layer with configurable attention dimension and dropout for sentence representations
create_maxpool_module: create a max pooling module that extracts the maximum value across the sequence dimension of input tensors
create_meanpool_module: create a mean pooling module that averages input tensors by sequence length for variable-length sequences
build_boundary_pool: build a boundary pooling module to extract first, last, or concatenated first-last token representations
create_lasttimestep_pool: create a last timestep pooling module that gathers the final hidden state based on sequence lengths
